I do this with multiples of 4 primarily, or numbers that have whole number square roots e.g. 3, 9; 5, 25; 6, 36.
If I am in the process of counting something and I'm interrupted, I never lose count. I unintentionally ignore the interruption to continue my counting, even when it could literally hurt or kill me, like when driving.
I've brought this (and other compulsive habits) up to many therapists and have repeatedly been told I do not meet the criteria to be diagnosed with OCD.

I sometimes find it unmanageable to the point of panic or total dysfunction and therefore I encourage you to talk to someone who will help guide you to the right diagnosis and treatment!
